about.title: About me
about.subtitle: Senior Frontend Engineer · Architecture · Design systems · Performance
paragraphs: I'm a **Senior Frontend Engineer** with **6+ years** shipping production **React** and **Next.js** products across **healthcare**, **fintech**, **travel booking**, and **SaaS**. I own large frontend systems end to end: **App Router** architecture, **design systems**, domain modeling, **SSR** and **SEO**, **accessibility**, and performance work that cut initial load by about **40%** and key page load by about **25%**.

At **Tapsi Doctor** I own architecture and delivery standards across five production surfaces — patient app, consultation suite, operations console, physician workspace, and a shared design system (**Raasti Kit**). I partner closely with product, design, and backend, and I care how interfaces feel as much as how they scale.

I'm seeking a **Senior Frontend** role in the **Netherlands** (Amsterdam, Rotterdam, Utrecht) with room to grow into **Staff**-level ownership. **Kennismigrant** sponsorship eligible. Languages: **Fluent English**; native Persian; professional Turkish; Dutch at **A2**, progressing to B1.
